name: @mgread-plugin/elkoparts-net
description: MgRead Node 24 source for the public Elkoparts novel site.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/contract.test.mjs test/packaging.test.mjs test/source.test.mjs
scripts.pack:plugin: npm run build && node tools/mgread.mjs pack
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:plugin

mgread.description: 饿狼小说是网络小说阅读网站，提供分类书目和小说作品页面。可按书名查找作品，查看介绍、完整章节目录与小说正文。
